# World Population Review

> > Comprehensive global and regional population statistics, census data, and demographic analysis covering countries, cities, and communities worldwide.

World Population Review provides real-time population tracking, demographic trends, and detailed census statistics for countries and cities globally, with extensive coverage of Canadian municipalities, U.S. cities, and international population rankings. The site aggregates data from national census bureaus including the Canadian Census, U.S. Census Bureau, and international demographic sources to deliver current population figures and growth projections.

## Key Topics

- World Population Statistics
- Canadian Census Data
- Population Growth Trends
- Demographic Analysis
- Country Population Rankings
- City Demographics
- Population Density Metrics
- Census Demographics
- Global Population Projections
- Regional Population Data
- Municipal Statistics
- Population Counters
- Demographic Indicators
- Urban Population Trends
- Community Demographics

## Overview

- [Current World Population: 8,298,978,817](https://worldpopulationreview.com): Homepage with live world population counter and global demographic rankings
- [About World Population Review](http://www.worldpopulationreview.com/about): About page with team info (Shane Fulmer, Daniel Stout) and mission
